name: Drill: craft a chest, place it and store items
context: Containers practice. Needs 8 planks (any wood). Survival world, wherever the player is now; never assume coordinates, find things with mc_find_blocks. Never dig the block under your own feet or straight down; dig staircases or side tunnels. Avoid lava and deep water (mc_mine allowFluids only for sand/gravel at shores). Do not break blocks of player-built structures.

steps.name: craft a chest
steps.goal: Craft 1 chest (8 planks in a ring) at a crafting table with mc_craft chest; craft planks from logs first if you have fewer than 8. mc_craft handles the crafting table by itself (uses one within 6 blocks, or places yours or makes one from 4 planks, and picks it back up).

steps.name: place the chest and store items
steps.goal: Place the chest on the ground 2 blocks away (mc_place item=chest). Open it (mc_look at it, mc_interact use). Move every stack of dirt, gravel, sand and seeds you carry into it with mc_click_slot mode=quick_move on your inventory slots (mc_observe lists the slots). If you carry none of those, move 1 stack of cobblestone instead.
steps.verify: the chest block exists where you placed it (mc_blocks) and mc_observe shows those items left your inventory.
